text_block_list.text:
Although Мэдзиро МакКуин puts up a
strong fight
for first, she loses her match
with Мэдзиро Райан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, she can't simply hang her head
in
shame. She bounces back from defeat,
declaring
that she'll train harder and
become even stronger.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан expresses her gratitude for
their
sincere match. But there is still
more to come, and
she doesn't intend to
lose.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so... Мэдзиро МакКуин sets her sights
on her
next objective: the spring Tenno
Sho. She is eager
to show the
culmination of all her hard work.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
